rendered: The authors used the FTIR band at 871 cm^−1[1] (the bending vibration of CH2, a representative PVDF peak) to check whether PVDF remained in the reclaimed cathode powder. The band was present for the cathode rejects and for the powder filtered at room temperature, indicating PVDF was still there.[2][3][4] The band was absent for the reclaimed powder filtered at high temperature (hot filtration), which the authors took as demonstrating removal of the PVDF binder.[5][6][7]
